name: GetDataCronClearTaskDetailList

parameters.help_zh: 工单号，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208385.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

DataCronClearTaskDetailList.description_zh: 历史数据清理任务执行列表

items.description_en: The execution details of each task

ActualAffectRows.description_en: The number of rows affected by the SQL task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the SQL task was created

DBTaskGroupId.description_en: The ID of the SQL task group

jobStatus.description_en:
The state of the SQL task. Valid values:

INIT: The SQL task was initialized.
PENDING: The SQL task waited to be run.
BE_SCHEDULED: The SQL task waited to be scheduled.
FAIL: The SQL task failed.
SUCCESS: The SQL task was successful.
PAUSE: The SQL task was paused.
DELETE: The SQL task was deleted.
RUNNING: The SQL task was being run
jobStatus.description_zh:
SQL详情状态，取值：
INIT：初始化状态
PENDING：等待任务抓取
BE_SCHEDULED：待调度
FAIL：执行失败
SUCCESS：执行成功
PAUSE：暂停
DELETE：删除
RUNNING：正在执行

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of SQL tasks
